FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Larchwood Liquids Pipeline Inc.
REPORTED BY
Control-room operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
I got a call from control at 12:00 on Feb 3, 2026, about a CO2 leak at Larchwood Liquids Pipeline
Inc.'s Montreal East station. SCADA indicated a release. The leak is through the pipe body or a
weld, not sure which. Metering shows 20.0 m³ released. Control said everything is still inside the
station fence. They didn't give me any other details. I haven't spoken to ops on site yet. The
product released is CO2. I'll try to get more info from the field team and follow up.
S. Patel, On-Call CRO
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
